title: Local S3-compatible dev server that maps a plain directory, with a built-in UI
user: Application developers who need a lightweight S3 endpoint in local development and tests.
smallest_useful_product: A single binary exposing core S3 operations over ordinary files, with multipart uploads, presigned request support, CORS, metadata and tag sidecars, fixture seeding, and event webhooks.
constraints: Development only; no IAM, versioning, replication, erasure coding, or production-readiness claim.
